name: disable-automatic-tab-discarding
description: Keep Chrome tabs alive — prevent automatic tab discarding, with per-site rules, stats and themes.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run copy && tsc
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run minify && mkdir -p release && rm -f release/keep-tabs-alive-v1.0.0.zip && cd dist && zip -r -X -q ../release/keep-tabs-alive-v1.0.0.zip . -x '*.DS_Store'
